decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to assemble the "Full English Breakfast" combo, which involves using Hermit Druid to mill your entire library, then reanimate a combo piece like Phyrexian Devourer or Triskelion to win the game. The deck utilizes cards like Cabal Therapy and Mesmeric Fiend to disrupt opponents' game plans, while also running a suite of mana accelerators like Birds of Paradise and Elvish Spirit Guide to help cast the combo pieces quickly. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn, without giving opponents a chance to respond.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base using cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while controlling the game with various removal spells and Winter's Grasp. Oath of Druids serves as a win condition by cheating out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck aims to lock down the board, ramp up mana quickly, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The combination of control elements and ramp allows the deck to establish dominance and win the game through efficient plays and resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a mix of hand disruption, removal spells, and recursion effects to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By using creatures like Ravenous Baloth and Call of the Herd to generate threats and Pernicious Deed to clear the board when needed, the deck can maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Natural Order provides a powerful way to tutor for key creatures, while cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's hand and prevent them from executing their game plan effectively.

The deck focuses on using the Tinker card to find powerful artifacts like Altar of Dementia and Phyrexian Devourer, which can combo with Fling to deal massive damage to the opponent. This combo is supported by cards like Burning Wish to find key pieces and Defense Grid to protect the combo from disruption. The deck also includes mana acceleration in the form of Mox Diamond and other mana rocks to quickly power out the combo pieces. The goal is to set up the combo as quickly as possible and win the game in one explosive turn.

The main idea of this deck is to use Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence to draw cards whenever an enchantment enters the battlefield. By combining these card draw engines with powerful enchantments like Elephant Grass, Sterling Grove, and Sylvan Library, the deck aims to set up a lock on the opponent while generating card advantage. Additionally, the deck can utilize Replenish to bring back enchantments from the graveyard and overwhelm the opponent with a high enchantment count. The goal is to establish a strong board presence and control the game through enchantments.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using a variety of Goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to bring out key creatures quickly, supported by Goblin Warchief and Goblin King to boost their power, the deck aims to deal damage rapidly and efficiently. Additionally, cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Pyrokinesis provide additional control and removal options to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Final Fortune adds an element of risk and potential reward to the deck's overall strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with small, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By applying early pressure and consistently dealing damage to the opponent's life total, the strategy aims to close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The use of efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate along with creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic helps to maintain a fast pace and prevent the opponent from establishing a board presence. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Fireblast provides additional reach to finish off the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to consistently deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent, utilizing low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan by forcing them to react defensively to the fast-paced, high-intensity plays of the Aggro - Sligh archetype. With a strong emphasis on burn damage and direct creature damage, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize and mount a defense.

The main idea of this Aluren combo deck is to use cards like Aluren and Survival of the Fittest to create a loop where you can continuously play and bounce creatures for free, generating value and eventually winning the game through card advantage and overwhelming your opponent with your board presence. The deck focuses on efficiency and consistency, utilizing cards like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots to ramp up and cast your combo pieces as quickly as possible while also disrupting your opponent's game plan with cards like Meddling Mage and Rishadan Cutpurse.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by disrupting your opponent's strategy, removing their threats, and gaining card advantage through cards like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict. The deck also focuses on gaining life and generating card advantage with cards like Exalted Angel and Decree of Justice. With a mix of removal spells, card draw, and threats that can close out the game, this BW Control deck aims to dominate the battlefield and outlast the opponent in a longer game.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey, Goblin Piledriver, and Goblin Warchief to quickly build a board presence and deal damage quickly. The deck also includes removal options like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize to deal with opposing threats. Rishadan Port and Wasteland help to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Siege-Gang Commander provides additional reach and board presence. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly through sheer aggression and synergy within the Goblin tribe.

The deck focuses on using control elements such as Sphere of Resistance and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt opponents while utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. The mana base is centered around land destruction with Wasteland and Rishadan Port to slow down opponents, while also including efficient creature lands like Mishra's Factory and Treetop Village. The deck aims to control the game state through disruption and efficient creature threats, leveraging the Oath of Druids as a powerful tool to overwhelm opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the "Replenish" card as a central piece in a combo strategy. By strategically utilizing cards like Frantic Search, Intuition, and Stifle, the player aims to quickly fill their graveyard with enchantments such as Opalescence, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave. This enables them to bring back multiple enchantments from their graveyard using Replenish, overwhelming their opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing to control the game and protect their combo pieces.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that can continuously recur and generate value, disrupting opponents with hand disruption and removal spells while maintaining board presence with creatures like Ravenous Baloth and Deranged Hermit. Survival of the Fittest serves as a key engine in the deck, allowing for creature tutoring and graveyard recursion. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of resource management and threat deployment, ultimately outlasting opponents through attrition and card advantage. It emphasizes resilience and adaptability, able to pivot between aggressive and defensive strategies as needed.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board while maintaining a lock on the game. Utilizing cards like The Rack, Ensnaring Bridge, and Cursed Scroll to control the tempo of the match, the deck also includes disruptive spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The deck aims to strip the opponent of resources while deploying threats like Mishra's Factory to close out the game. With a mix of discard, removal, and prison effects, this deck aims to maintain control and grind out a victory.

The primary strategy of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost, efficient creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Wild Mongrel to quickly build a board presence. Utilizing the Madness mechanic with cards like Arrogant Wurm and Basking Rootwalla allows for additional value and tempo advantage. Circular Logic and Mana Leak provide disruption to control the opponent's plays, while card draw spells like Frantic Search and Deep Analysis ensure consistency. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board control while using a combination of evasion and counterspells to protect its threats.
